Name: Uproar!
Overview:
Uproar! is a side-scrolling beat-em up, switching from the traditional 2d graphics, to modern polygonal graphics, adding depth and realism.

The player takes control of a man trying to restore order during a chaotic city-wide riot. Facing off against gangs and armed thugs, the player must restore order in the only way they understand, with a good beatdown!
